keyword: what time does the masters start
claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
Tee times begin around 10:30 a.m. ET for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
Featured group streaming starts at 10:15 a.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and apps for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
Featured Groups streaming is from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+ for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
Early TV coverage is from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+ for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
TV coverage is from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tee off at 2:25 p.m. ET as the final pairing for the final round of the 2026 Masters.
